findings.title: Legacy Creature Biome Gap Breaks Chitin Armor, Spirit Essence, and Demon Core on Veyra
findings.evidence: VEYRA_BIOME_CREATURE omits wolf, toad, crawler, beetle, and crab. In 12 Veyra scene runs, 0 wolf/toad/crawler/beetle/crab spawn. Consequently chitin_armor (needs chitin from beetle), essence_spirit (crawler_optic), core_demon (crawler_optic), and shell_glass (crab shell) lose primary creature drops on Veyra (note: slime_3/vampire_3 supply crystal/essence_spirit partly, but beetle/chitin has ZERO drop path on Veyra).

findings.title: po_greywater Tackle Box Collision & po_glade T.ROAD Tile Drop Authored/Archetype Caches
findings.evidence: Across all 81 Veyra POIs: 23/24 authored caches materialize (po_greywater Tackle Box lost to Cottage Ladder at 1642,1176) and 57/58 archetype POIs materialize (po_glade uses T.ROAD stone paving, failing pickCell() T.FLOOR check).

findings.title: Veyra Lacks Airdrops, Loot Ecology, Recycler, and CreatorLootV1 Core Guarantees
findings.evidence: Shipping runs receive 14 airdrops (+28 MP, +28 fasteners, fuel/refined energy), LOOT_GRAMMAR_CURRENT (b05-v1), Foundry Recycler, and 5 guaranteed CREATOR_LOOT_V1 Creator Cores. Veyra gets 0 airdrops, undefined lootEcology, no Recycler, and 0 CREATOR_LOOT_V1 cores.

findings.title: Journey Requisitions Mint 7.7x Entire Run Vendor Cap Off-Map, Bypassing Ragnarok & Escrow
findings.evidence: Completing daily waypoints pays +42 securedCash/day = 588 securedCash over 14 days directly to profile, bypassing physical rcash, 72h Ragnarok gating, and the 30 rcash escrow_chest — while VENDOR_SECURED holds only 76 securedCash of total stock per run (Veyra also adds 275 rcash).

findings.title: Base Generator Burns 1 Fuel Canister in 60s (10x Faster Than POI Gen, Worse Than Coal/Briquette)
findings.evidence: base_generator consumes 1 fuel_can (3 salvaged_oil + 1 glass) in 60s per connected load (15 min full 3-slot capacity), while 1 coal lasts 80s and 1 fuel_briquette lasts 90s. Running 1 turret 24h requires 1,440 fuel_cans (~3,600 salvaged_oil), vs only 32 salvaged_oil available in an entire Shipping run.

findings.title: Random Research Excludes All 9 core_* Recipes Until All 26 Non-Core Recipes Are Exhausted
findings.evidence: Random research filters pool = unknown.filter(k => !k.startsWith('core_')). Since directed research blocks Tier 3, unlocking Tier-3 core_dragon (or any unfound core on Veyra) via research requires burning 104 spares across 26 non-core recipes first.

findings.title: Classic BuildPanel Omits ir_sensor and bear_trap From BUILD_ORDER Filter
findings.evidence: BUILD_GROUPS.Defense in panels.tsx:411 lists ir_sensor and bear_trap, but panels.tsx:420 filters BUILD_ORDER (catalog.ts:450) which omits both keys. Only SurvivorScreen DEVICE_STRUCTS surfaces them.

findings.title: BAL.economy.claimMinDistFromPoi (10 Tiles) Is Declared in balance.v1.json But Unchecked in buildReason()
findings.evidence: Live buildReason() probe placed floor_wood + Territory Cabinet at dist=9 tiles (< claimMinDistFromPoi=10) from Crossroads Trading Post (100,111) with zero rejection.

findings.title: Strategic Ores on Veyra Are Hyper-Concentrated into Isolated Windows (0 Iron/Crystal/Sulfur at 3/4 Spawns)
findings.evidence: Across all 12 Veyra scenes, sulfur spawns in only 1/12 scenes (veyra05-cinder), crystal in only 2/12 (veyra05-hook,veyra05-argus), and iron in 5/12 (veyra05-gulf,veyra05-greyback,veyra05-argus,veyra05-slag,veyra05-saltwick). Standard spawn westmouth/greywater have 0 iron, 0 coal, 0 crystal, 0 sulfur (while palm=66 does spawn on warm coastal code=9 windows).

findings.title: Territory Upkeep (25%/day = 350% Over 14 Days) Bills Fractional Rare Parts & Rounds Up Discrete Units
findings.evidence: Over a 336h run, a covered base pays 3.5x full build cost in ALL 12 territory materials (including brick, iron_ingot, spares, mechanical_parts, fasteners, glass). Because 24-slot Cabinets share slots across all billed materials, a multi-material citadel runs out of rare-material slots or wood far faster than 336h.

findings.title: Campfire Burns Loaded Fuel 24/7 When Idle & Tooltip Claims Stale 2h Decay (Actual 12h)
findings.evidence: Live idle probe burned 30 wood in 10 min on an empty campfire queue vs 0 on an empty furnace. Meanwhile Game.tsx:825 & journey.ts:81 still warn "~2h decay" after W08 raised unprotectedCollapseHours to 12h.

findings.title: Oil Pump & Crude Petroleum Chain Is Permanently Disabled Outside Test Fixtures (TEST_FIXTURE_ONLY)
findings.evidence: oil_pump, pump_crude, crude_petroleum, and refinery_crude are seeded as known recipes/buildables, yet oilPumpV1 disables production placement without an oilTestFixture === true run flag.

findings.title: Discrete Ceil(0.25*q) Repair Charges 100% Material Cost on Qty=1 Components While Reclaim Refunds 0
findings.evidence: structureRepairCost uses max(1, ceil(q * 0.25)) per material. On qty=1 costs (e.g. door_wood rope, wall_stone wood, chest_large iron/wood edges), repairing 25% HP charges 100% of that ingredient (17 structure-ingredient pairs affected).

findings.title: Live Recycler v3 & Component v4 Rules Enforce Net-Loss Recovery (Historical v2 Over-Return Closed)
findings.evidence: All live recycler plans (X:recover-v1, X:recover-v3, X:gear-v1, X:pipe-v2, X:blade-v1) return strictly <= craft input ingot-equivalents. Legacy X:recover-v2 (retained only for pre-patch saved jobs) had OVER_RETURN on iron_sword, iron_pick, iron_axe, industrial_axe.

findings.title: stepStations Explicitly Skips oil_pump While Off-Window on Veyra (Unlike Smelters/Refineries/Livestock)
findings.evidence: Live Veyra offscreen probe confirmed oil_pump in r.veyraOffscreenEntities produced 0 crude_petroleum over 5s while consuming 0 oil stock (oilPumpOffscreenSkipped=true), whereas furnaces, refineries, gardens, and livestock simulate offscreen.

findings.title: Refined Energy (CreatorCore Signature/Refined Ammo) Is Tightly Bottlenecked by Wild Sulfur & Crystal Stocks
findings.evidence: Each energy_refined requires {"crystal":1,"iron_ingot":1} (out=4). Shipping holds 105 sulfur and 93 crystal total wild units (max 93 refined charges if 100% mined); Veyra sampled 12 windows yielded 540 sulfur nodes and 468 crystal nodes.
